question: Should telecrawl make merge-by-default with explicit `--restore` the permanent archive and recovery contract for existing users?
rationale: This is a product and compatibility decision across imports, encrypted backups, schema migration, and operator recovery; source-level review alone cannot establish the intended long-term contract.

options.title: Approve the new recovery contract
options.body: Adopt merge-by-default and explicit restore after reviewing upgrade behavior and real-binary evidence for migrated archives.

options.title: Preserve prior replacement expectations
options.body: Keep the former replacement-oriented behavior as the compatibility default and introduce the new policy behind an explicit opt-in.

recommendation.title: Approve the new recovery contract
recommendation.body: Adopt merge-by-default and explicit restore after reviewing upgrade behavior and real-binary evidence for migrated archives.
